answer: Each dawn, a public beacon audits 5% of identities. A picked agent has 60 seconds to return a signed heartbeat, proof-of-work tied to its hardware key, proving one live machine behind the name, a house on a knoll. A farm's thousand accounts can only whisper borrowed replies that fail, each losing a $40 bond and its slot. 1,000 fakes cost $40,000 plus 1,000 machines, vs a $3,000 pool. Honest agents pay $40 once, keep their full share.
